Class TagEkf

java.lang.Object
frc.spectrumLib.localization.TagEkf
public class TagEkf extends Object
An extended Kalman filter over (x, y, heading) that takes every camera's tags one at a time, in the style of 971's AOS localizer: each tag is a bearing and a distance from its camera, so a single or far tag still corrects the pose at a low weight instead of being thrown away, and every camera feeds the same estimate.
  • Predict on every odometry sample: wheel translation, gyro heading change. Variance grows with distance driven, and more when the modules disagree with each other or with the gyro (slip). Heading gets very little.
  • Correct per tag, at the frame's capture time. About HISTORY_SECONDS of states are kept; a frame is inserted at its time and odometry and later frames are replayed over it, so the result does not depend on arrival order.
  • Reject a tag whose innovation fails a chi-squared test. If tags keep failing for RELOCALIZE_SECONDS, the covariance is widened so the cameras can pull it back.

Noise values are starting points to tune against logs, not measured.
